The stock fell 16% following the report and an additional 13% after a Cantor Fitzgerald downgrade.

Smith announced securities fraud class action lawsuits against four publicly-traded companies: BitGo Holdings, Via Transportation, Zillow Group, and ADMA Biologics. The complaints allege that defendants made false or misleading statements regarding their business operations, financial performance, and prospects. Investors have until August 7-10, 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

top.title: Construction demands rise to 2035 in Manitoba, as notable non-residential project activity is supplemented by modest residential growth
top.summary: Manitoba's construction sector is expected to grow through 2035, driven primarily by non-residential projects including engineering, ICI building, and major infrastructure initiatives. While residential construction will see modest growth with new housing declining but renovations increasing, the sector faces a potential labor shortage of 1,700 workers by 2035 despite record apprenticeship registrations. Employment in non-residential construction is projected to rise 11% by 2035.

top.title: La demande en construction augmente au Manitoba jusqu’en 2035, portée par d’importants projets non résidentiels et une croissance modérée du secteur résidentiel
top.summary: ConstruForce Canada projects construction activity in Manitoba will grow through 2035, with non-residential projects in engineering, utilities, and infrastructure driving expansion while residential construction moderates. The sector faces a potential labor shortage of 1,700 workers by 2035 despite record apprenticeship enrollments, requiring recruitment efforts targeting women, Indigenous peoples, and immigrants.

top.title: US judge approves Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement of copyright lawsuit
top.summary: A federal judge in San Francisco on Monday signed off on artificial intelligence company Anthropic's landmark $1.5 billion settlement of a class action lawsuit brought by a group ‌of authors who accused it of misusing their books to train its AI chatbot Claude.  U.S. District ‌Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin granted final approval of the settlement, the largest known settlement of a U.S. copyright case, rejecting arguments that ​it was too small.  The case is one of dozens brought by copyright owners including authors and news outlets against tech companies over the training of their large language models, and the first major U.S. case to settle.

top.title: BMI IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages Badger Meter, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important August 3 Deadline in Securities Class Action - BMI
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting lead plaintiffs for securities class action lawsuits against Badger Meter, Inc., First Solar, Inc., and Gildan Activewear Inc. The firm alleges that Badger Meter made false statements about financial results by pulling forward customer orders to conceal weakening demand. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to join before the August 3, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Badger Meter, Inc. Investors Have Until August 3rd to Contact Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Seeking Lead Plaintiff Role
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Badger Meter, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about strong financial performance driven by sustainable demand, when results were actually driven by pulling forward customer orders that concealed weakening demand. The company's stock fell over 24% on April 17, 2026, after disappointing Q1 2026 results revealed significant declines in sales and earnings. Investors have until August 3, 2026 to apply for lead plaintiff status.

top.title: BMI Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Badger Meter, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm

top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased Peabody Energy common stock between October 14, 2024 and May 4, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit. top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Peabody Energy Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Peabody Energy Corporation for allegedly making false statements about the Centurion mine's commissioning status and financial impact. The company claimed the project was 'on time and on budget' while concealing significant operational challenges. Following disclosures in March and May 2026, BTU stock declined approximately 37%, from $39.50 to $25.00 per share. Investors who purchased securities between October 14, 2024 and May 4, 2026 may be eligible to join the lawsuit.

top.title: BTU Stockholders Have Rights – If You Lost Money Investing in Peabody Energy Corporation Contact Robbins LLP for Information About Recovering Your Losses
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Peabody Energy Corporation (NYSE: BTU) on behalf of investors who purchased stock between October 14, 2024 and May 4, 2026. Shareholders allege the company misled investors about production rates at its Centurion mine, providing overly optimistic guidance that failed to materialize. The stock declined 9.7% on March 30, 2026 following a guidance cut, and another 5.7% on May 5, 2026 when the company disclosed failure to meet the mine's ramp-up deadline.

The primary focus is on Embecta Corp., where investors who purchased stock between November 25, 2025 and May 4, 2026 may be entitled to compensation. Investors who purchased Calix securities between January 28, 2026 and April 21, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of July 27, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: clear runway to the call wall with put-wall support below
reasons.zh: 上行至 Call 墙空间充裕，下方有 Put 墙支撑

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.0 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Century Aluminum and Emirates Global Aluminum announced plans to build a new aluminum smelter in Inola, Oklahoma, with capacity for 750,000 tonnes of production. President Trump's executive order reduces tariff rates from 50% to 25% for companies investing in new U.S. primary aluminum production, supporting the project which is expected to create over 1,000 direct jobs and 4,000 construction jobs. Century is also expanding capacity at its Mt. Holly plant in South Carolina.

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (200) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（200）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -5.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -5.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: 4DMT Announces Positive 2-Year Data from PRISM Phase 2b Clinical Trial in a Broad Wet AMD Population
top.summary: 4D Molecular Therapeutics (4DMT) announced positive 2-year results from its PRISM Phase 2b clinical trial of 4D-150, an intravitreal gene therapy for wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD). The single-dose treatment demonstrated consistent maintenance of visual acuity and anatomic control with 78-87% reduction in treatment burden compared to standard aflibercept injections. The therapy was well-tolerated with no new safety concerns or intraocular inflammation cases beyond the first 6 months.

top.title: GRAL DEADLINE ALERT: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages GRAIL, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important August 4 Deadline in Securities Class Action – GRAL
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors who suffered losses in GRAIL, Inc., First Solar, Inc., and Gildan Activewear Inc. to join securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves GRAIL, Inc., where defendants allegedly made materially false statements about their NHS-Galleri trial results and concealed adverse facts about the trial's ability to demonstrate cancer reduction outcomes. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

top.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages First Solar, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FSLR
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLR) alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's capacity to manage U.S. tariff policy impacts. The lawsuit claims defendants overstated First Solar's ability to handle tariffs and understated negative impacts from production facility underutilization in Malaysia and Vietnam, as well as U.S. relocation efforts. Investors who purchased FSLR securities between February 26, 2025 and February 24, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 24, 2026.

top.title: BMI IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages Badger Meter, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important August 3 Deadline in Securities Class Action - BMI
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting lead plaintiffs for securities class action lawsuits against Badger Meter, Inc., First Solar, Inc., and Gildan Activewear Inc. The firm alleges that Badger Meter made false statements about financial results by pulling forward customer orders to conceal weakening demand. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to join before the August 3, 2026 deadline.

top.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Photronics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – PLAB
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Photronics, Inc., First Solar, Inc., and Intuit Inc., alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements to investors. In the Photronics case, the firm claims the company concealed a critical bottleneck in its design release pipeline and falsely promised seasonal recovery following Chinese New Year. Investors who purchased securities during the specified class periods are encouraged to seek counsel before the lead plaintiff deadline of September 4, 2026.

top.title: IndiGo and CFM sign MOU paving the way to a record agreement for 1,000+ LEAP-1A engines
top.summary: IndiGo, India's largest airline, announced a record MoU with CFM International for 1,000+ LEAP-1A engines to power 510 Airbus A320neo Family aircraft. The deal includes CFM's support for establishing IndiGo's engine MRO facility and long-term material services. This marks the largest single LEAP engine order ever placed and strengthens the decade-long partnership between the companies.

top.title: GEnx-1B Engines Surpass 50 Million Flight Hours
top.summary: GE Aerospace announced that its GEnx-1B engine has reached 50 million flight hours in just over 14 years, the fastest rate for any GE commercial widebody engine. The engine powers Boeing 787 Dreamliners and maintains a 99.98% dispatch reliability rate. GE Aerospace is investing $1 billion in U.S. manufacturing and supply chain enhancements to meet growing demand.

top.title: AI Made Building Software Cheap. Votito Launches to Answer the Harder Question: What to Build
top.summary: Votito, a new product management platform, launches to help small teams and non-traditional product managers conduct user research and discover what features to build. The platform addresses a shift in software development where AI has made coding faster, but identifying what to build has become the constraint. As teams shrink into smaller 'pods' augmented with AI, traditional product expertise is becoming scarce, requiring developers and business users to take on product management responsibilities.

top.title: BrightEdge Research: Google AI Cites Facebook in 19.5 Million Answers as Social Platforms Become AI Discovery Sources
top.summary: BrightEdge research reveals Google's AI is drawing significant information from Meta's social platforms, with Facebook appearing in 19.5 million AI Overviews and Instagram in 877,000. The study shows Google AI treats different social platforms as experts for different categories—Facebook for local/community information, Instagram for culture/entertainment, TikTok for trends, Reddit for experiences, and YouTube for instructional content. This shift means marketers must optimize beyond owned channels and understand which specific social sources influence AI-generated answers in their category.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Harrow Highlights Growing Clinical Evidence Supporting IHEEZO® and BYOOVIZ® at ASRS 2026 Annual Meeting
top.summary: Harrow announced presentations of three studies supporting its ophthalmic products IHEEZO (chloroprocaine HCl ophthalmic gel) and BYOOVIZ (ranibizumab-nuna biosimilar) at the ASRS 2026 Annual Meeting. Interim findings from a randomized study showed IHEEZO demonstrated encouraging trends toward less post-injection pain and better patient experience compared to subconjunctival lidocaine. A large real-world analysis of nearly 20,000 injections found no increased endophthalmitis risk with IHEEZO. The company continues enrollment in the QUELL clinical trial with topline data expected in Q4 2026.

top.title: ROSEN, A RANKED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Hub Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HUBG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging Hub Group, Inc. (HUBG) investors who purchased securities between April 28, 2023 and May 11, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Hub Group made false and misleading statements regarding its financial statements, with material misstatements in revenue recognition, operating income, and expense reporting across multiple quarters. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 28, 2026.

top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors who purchased securities in Verra Mobility Corporation, Hub Group, Inc., and Via Transportation, Inc. during specified periods to join class action lawsuits. top.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages First Solar, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FSLR
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against First Solar, Inc., Photronics, Inc., and Intuit Inc. The First Solar lawsuit alleges the company made materially false statements regarding its capacity to manage U.S. tariff policy impacts and overstated projected performance for fiscal year 2026. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to join the litigation before the August 24, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Photronics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – PLAB
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Photronics, Inc., First Solar, Inc., and Intuit Inc., alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements to investors. In the Photronics case, the firm claims the company concealed a critical bottleneck in its design release pipeline and falsely promised seasonal recovery following Chinese New Year. Investors who purchased securities during the specified class periods are encouraged to seek counsel before the lead plaintiff deadline of September 4, 2026.

top.title: Transactions in connection with share buyback programme
top.summary: ISS A/S, a global workplace experience and facility management company, continues its share buyback programme announced in February 2026. ISS now holds 3,935,004 treasury shares representing 2.46% of total share capital. The programme aims to redistribute excess cash to shareholders and support share-based incentive obligations.

top.title: JCDecaux connecte 100 % de son inventaire DOOH au programmatique dans 9 marchés d’Amérique Latine
top.summary: JCDecaux has launched its programmatic Digital Out-of-Home (pDOOH) offering across 9 Latin American countries, connecting 100% of its regional inventory to automated buying platforms. The expansion covers over 4,600 digital screens delivering 8.2 billion monthly impressions through VIOOH and integrated DSPs, enabling advertisers to execute data-driven campaigns with greater flexibility and precision across urban, transport, and retail environments.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Lucid Group, Inc. (LCID) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Lucid Group (LCID) for allegedly making materially false statements about its business operations. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased securities between February 25, 2026 and April 13, 2026. Lucid faced significant delivery disruptions due to supplier quality issues with second-row seats, resulting in missed revenue guidance ($282.47M vs. $433.8M consensus) and substantial operational losses exceeding $1 billion. The stock declined significantly following multiple negative announcements in April and May 2026. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is July 28, 2026.

top.title: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Embecta Corp. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – EMBC
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple securities class action lawsuits. vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.summary: Robbins LLP is investigating Megan Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: MGN) for allegedly being the subject of a pump and dump scheme involving market manipulation and fraudulent promotion. The company failed to disclose risks of fraudulent trading and market manipulation. MGN's stock collapsed 93.4% on March 26, 2026, from $4.24 to $0.28 per share, and has not recovered. Shareholders can join the class action with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 4, 2026.

top.title: Antiparasitic Drugs Market Report Released — Examines Antimalarials, Anthelmintics, Antiprotozoals, Ectoparasiticides, and Neglected Tropical Disease Therapies
top.summary: The global antiparasitic drugs market is projected to grow from USD 23.30 billion in 2026 to USD 30.98 billion by 2032 at a 4.88% CAGR. Growth is driven by persistent parasitic disease burden, drug resistance, climate-sensitive vector transmission, and public health programs. Key opportunities include resistance-ready combination therapies, pediatric formulations, AI-enabled discovery, and diagnostics-linked prescribing, with Africa and Asia-Pacific leading endemic demand.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.3 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Meridian Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MRDN) announced that its subsidiary Meridianbet has been named the Official Sponsor of UFC Fight Night Serbia, scheduled for August 1, 2026 at Belgrade Arena. This marks the first UFC event ever held in Serbia, with Meridianbet serving as the exclusive sports-betting category sponsor. The sponsorship includes Octagon branding, marketing placements, and digital campaigns across UFC's global platforms.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.9 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.0 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: PICS Investors Have Opportunity to Lead PicS N.V. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
top.summary: The Schall Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against PicS N.V. (NASDAQ: PICS) for violations of federal securities laws related to its January 2026 IPO. The company allegedly made false and misleading statements about its credit evaluation procedures, which were found to be insufficient during an internal investigation. The IPO documents allegedly overstated underwriting quality and failed to disclose risks of heightened defaults and adverse financial trends.

The lawsuit alleges that PicS made false or misleading statements in IPO documents regarding credit assessment procedures, credit quality deterioration, and undisclosed Stage 3 exposure reclassifications totaling approximately R$590 million, along with inadequate credit risk monitoring capabilities.

The lawsuit claims PicS failed to disclose deficient credit evaluation procedures, material reclassifications of credit exposures, undisclosed high Stage 3 formation rates, overstated credit models, and deteriorating customer credit quality. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

top.title: ROBLOX DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is seeking lead plaintiffs for a securities class action lawsuit against Roblox Corporation. The lawsuit alleges that Roblox provided misleading statements about its organic growth potential, concealing material facts about significant slowdowns in growth rates due to age verification rollout impacts, resulting in reduced app store ratings and diminished organic growth. Investors who purchased Roblox stock between October 30, 2025 and April 30, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 7, 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Roblox Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Roblox Corporation alleging that company executives made materially false and misleading statements about organic growth potential and failed to disclose the severity of headwinds from age verification rollout, including user enrollment slowdown and reduced app store ratings. Investors who purchased Roblox securities between October 31, 2024 and April 30, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 7, 2026.

top.title: BrightEdge Research: Google AI Cites Facebook in 19.5 Million Answers as Social Platforms Become AI Discovery Sources
top.summary: BrightEdge research reveals Google's AI is drawing significant information from Meta's social platforms, with Facebook appearing in 19.5 million AI Overviews and Instagram in 877,000. The study shows Google AI treats different social platforms as experts for different categories—Facebook for local/community information, Instagram for culture/entertainment, TikTok for trends, Reddit for experiences, and YouTube for instructional content. This shift means marketers must optimize beyond owned channels and understand which specific social sources influence AI-generated answers in their category.

top.summary: IndiGo, India's largest airline, announced a record MoU with CFM International for 1,000+ LEAP-1A engines to power 510 Airbus A320neo Family aircraft. The deal includes CFM's support for establishing IndiGo's engine MRO facility and long-term material services. This marks the largest single LEAP engine order ever placed and strengthens the decade-long partnership between the companies.

top.summary: The global antiparasitic drugs market is projected to grow from USD 23.30 billion in 2026 to USD 30.98 billion by 2032 at a 4.88% CAGR. Growth is driven by persistent parasitic disease burden, drug resistance, climate-sensitive vector transmission, and public health programs. Key opportunities include resistance-ready combination therapies, pediatric formulations, AI-enabled discovery, and diagnostics-linked prescribing, with Africa and Asia-Pacific leading endemic demand.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+4.4% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +4.4%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

reasons.en: clear runway to the call wall with put-wall support below
reasons.zh: 上行至 Call 墙空间充裕，下方有 Put 墙支撑

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Gentherm Medical Receives FDA Clearance for ThermAffyx™ Patient Safety System
top.summary: Gentherm announced FDA 510(k) clearance for its ThermAffyx Patient Safety System, a patented integrated device combining active patient warming, securement, and pressure reduction for robotic-assisted surgical procedures. Product trials begin in August with revenue expected in Q3 2026. The device addresses a critical gap where over 25% of robotic surgery patients experience hypothermia despite current warming interventions.

top.summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals reported Q2 2026 group revenue of US$247 million (up 7% QoQ, 21% YoY) with Precision Medicine revenue reaching US$202 million (up 30% YoY). The company achieved key regulatory milestones including FDA alignment on TLX591-Tx Phase 3 trial progression and near-completion of BiPASS patient enrollment. FY 2026 revenue guidance remains on track to exceed US$1 billion. Telix also entered a strategic collaboration with Regeneron and completed a convertible bond refinancing.

top.title: VIA Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Via Transportation, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
top.summary: The Schall Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Via Transportation, Inc. (NYSE: VIA) for securities fraud related to its September 2025 IPO. The company allegedly made false statements about its business growth and 'land and expand' strategy, particularly regarding German operations, while concealing declining Annual Run-Rate Revenue (ARR) and regulatory pressures in Germany that were revealed on May 12, 2026.

top.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Verra Mobility Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - VRRM
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors who purchased securities in Verra Mobility Corporation, Hub Group, Inc., and Via Transportation, Inc. during specified periods to join class action lawsuits. The firm alleges that Verra made materially false statements regarding its relationship with Avis Budget Group and concealed adverse facts about potential competition from in-house solutions.

top.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Via Transportation, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - VIA
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased Via Transportation, Inc. (NYSE: VIA) stock during its IPO to join a securities class action lawsuit before the August 10, 2026 deadline. The lawsuit alleges that Via's IPO offering documents were false and misleading, omitting information about declining Platform Annual Run-Rate Revenue and growth obstacles in Germany. Via's stock has declined approximately 70% from its IPO price to $14.52.

top.title: Circulating Supply of Enterprise Stablecoin USDGO Surpasses US$1 Billion, Ranking Among Top Six Regulated Stablecoins Globally
top.summary: OSL Group announced that USDGO, its enterprise-grade USD stablecoin, has surpassed US$1 billion in circulating supply, making it the sixth-largest compliant stablecoin globally and the largest operated by an Asian stablecoin operator. The stablecoin grew from US$100 million to US$1 billion in three months, demonstrating strong institutional demand for compliant stablecoins in emerging markets.

top.title: WGS DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING AND LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages GeneDx Holdings Corp. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - WGS
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors who purchased GeneDx Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: WGS) common stock between April 16, 2025 and May 4, 2026 of the August 3, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in an ongoing securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that GeneDx made false statements regarding the Fabric acquisition's positive impact on the company's financials and operations, when defendants knew of significant problems that would negatively impact the business.

top.title: WGS Investors Have Opportunity to Lead GeneDx Holdings Corp. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
top.summary: The Schall Law Firm is seeking investors who purchased GeneDx Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: WGS) securities between April 16, 2025 and May 4, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit alleging securities fraud. GeneDx revealed false and misleading statements regarding its Q1 2026 financial results, including a drop in adjusted gross margin, lowered earnings projections, and a $31.3 million impairment related to Fabric Genomics.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges GeneDx Holdings Corp. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against GeneDx Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: WGS) alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding Fabric Genomics, reimbursement rates durability, and gross margins during the period from April 16, 2025 to May 4, 2026. Investors who purchased GeneDx securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 3, 2026.

top.title: ZOETIS CLASS ACTION DEADLINE MONDAY JULY 27th: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Zoetis, Inc. Investors to Contact the Firm Before the July 27th Lead Plaintiff Deadline
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Zoetis, Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements and failing to disclose material adverse facts during the period from January 14, 2025 to May 6, 2026. The complaint alleges that Zoetis concealed weakening veterinarian adoption of its Librela product due to FDA safety warnings, significant market share losses in Simparica Trio to competitors, and declining market share for dermatology products Apoquel and Cytopoint. Investors have until July 27, 2026 to apply to be appointed as lead plaintiff.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Zoetis Inc. (ZTS) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Zoetis Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements and failing to disclose material adverse facts about its business. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Zoetis securities between January 14, 2025 and May 6, 2026. The company's stock declined significantly following three earnings announcements that revealed weakened demand in its Companion Animal portfolio, increased competition, and declining sales of key products including Librela, Simparica Trio, Apoquel, and Cytopoint. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is July 27, 2026.

top.title: ZOETIS DEADLINE: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Zoetis Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – ZTS
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Zoetis Inc. for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its Companion Animal products during the period from January 14, 2025 to May 6, 2026. The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose weakening veterinarian adoption of its Librela pain treatment following FDA safety warnings, significant market share losses in Simparica Trio to competitors, and declining market share in dermatology products Apoquel and Cytopoint.
